chip-height.$description: KINIG-138 (restyled): the height of a reaction chip inside a bubble (about 24 px at a 13 px root), fully rounded: tall enough to read as a button and not as a line of text. The emoji in it is the body text size.

chip-padding.$description: KINIG-138 (restyled): the left and right padding of a chip (9.75 px), so the pill is wider than its emoji and reads as a chip.

gap.$description: KINIG-138 (restyled): the gap between chips, and between the rows when they wrap (6.5 px).

row-offset.$description: KINIG-138 (restyled): the space between the text of an entry and its row of chips (9.75 px), so the chips are clearly apart from the text; an entry whose text is one emoji no longer looks like its chips.

divider-height.$description: KINIG-138: the height of the thin divider between the reaction buttons and the other buttons of the hover bar (14 px).

story-stage.$description: KINIG-138: the height of the Storybook stage that gives the full emoji picker room (stories only).

story-column.$description: KINIG-138: the height of the Storybook column in which a bubble stands at the bottom, as in the feed (stories only).

popover-gap.$description: KINIG-138: the gap between the buttons of the quick-reaction popover.
